svg.title: What LEVI does with robot data, README version: five tiers from reading data to a better policy
svg.desc: Five tiers: read and convert, check, label and judge, curate for training, and a better policy at the top. The first, second and fourth are built and tested on fixtures; label and judge is measured on two tasks with the bar met on one; a better policy is not established. The full version is figure 2 in the architecture atlas.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From raw data to a better policy

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each tier rests on the one below it. The top tier is the goal, and it is not proven yet.
